fields.title: Lead Welcome Email
fields.subject: Thanks for reaching out, {{ instance.first_name }}!
fields.body:
Hi {{ instance.first_name }},

Thanks for your interest. Our team will be in touch shortly.

fields.title: Deal Won Congratulations
fields.subject: Congratulations on winning {{ instance.name }}!
fields.body: Great news, {{ instance.name }} has been marked as won. Great work!

fields.title: New Inquiry Acknowledgement
fields.subject: We've received your inquiry, {{ instance.first_name }}!
fields.body:
Hi {{ instance.first_name }},

Thanks for getting in touch. A representative will follow up soon.

fields.title: Deal Closed Celebration
fields.subject: {{ instance.name }} just closed - congratulations!
fields.body: Fantastic work, {{ instance.name }} has been closed successfully!

fields.title: Campaign Launch Announcement
fields.subject: {{ instance.campaign_name }} is now live!
fields.body:
Hello,

We are excited to announce that {{ instance.campaign_name }} has started. It runs from {{ instance.start_date }} to {{ instance.end_date }}.

We would love for you to take part.

fields.title: Account Onboarding Welcome
fields.subject: Welcome aboard, {{ instance.name }}!
fields.body:
Hi {{ instance.name }} team,

Welcome! We are delighted to have you with us. Your account is set up and our team is ready to help you get started.

fields.title: Contact Follow-up
fields.subject: Great connecting with you, {{ instance.first_name }}!
fields.body:
Hi {{ instance.first_name }} {{ instance.last_name }},

It was great connecting with you. Let us know a good time to continue the conversation.

fields.title: Campaign Wrap-up Summary
fields.subject: {{ instance.campaign_name }} - campaign wrap-up
fields.body:
Hello,

The campaign {{ instance.campaign_name }} has ended. Its current status is {{ instance.status }}. Thank you to everyone who contributed.

fields.title: Account Review Invitation
fields.subject: Let's review your account, {{ instance.name }}
fields.body:
Hi {{ instance.name }} team,

We would like to schedule a short review of your account to make sure we are meeting your needs. Please let us know what time works for you.

fields.title: Contact Introduction Email
fields.subject: Nice to meet you, {{ instance.first_name }}
fields.body:
Hi {{ instance.first_name }},

Thanks for your time. I am sharing a short introduction about our company and how we can help you.
